Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2410)

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.

Observed:
- C was selected most often and rejected for: south refunds, north claims, east shipments, and east small claim. C accepted only for REQ-2408: small shipment, north region, from Regional Ops, “second attempt.”
- B accepted once: REQ-2409, large refund, east region, from Finance Desk, “asking twice.”
- B was rejected for REQ-2407: large claim, south region, Field Sales.
- A has not been tried; likely default when B/C fail.

Tentative rules:
- Claims: try A first. B/C have failed or been flagged invalid for north/south/east claims.
- Large refunds from east: B priority desk.
- Small shipments from north via Regional Ops: C regional office.
- Other refunds/shipments: start with A; do not default to C.

Caveats:
- Outcome text is inconsistent with selected option in places: step 6 selected B but says “C is not valid”; step 9 selected C but says “B is not valid.” Trust the success/reject flag over the message.
- Region, request type, size, sender role, and urgency phrases appear relevant, but no stable rule yet beyond the two accepted cases.
- Before escalating, check: region, claim/refund/shipment, small/large, sender desk/role, and repeat-contact wording.
- If A is rejected, test B for large refunds and C only for north small shipments.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2420)

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office. Trust success/reject flag over explanatory message.

Confirmed accepts:
- A: large invoice, east, Field Sales, “asking twice” (2414).
- A: large shipment, south, Finance Desk, “no rush” (2416).
- A: small shipment, south, Regional Ops, “second attempt” (2419).
- A: small claim, north, Regional Ops, “no rush” (2420).
- B: large refund, east, Finance Desk, “asking twice” (2409).
- C: small shipment, north, Regional Ops, “second attempt” (2408).

A rejected:
- large invoice, north, Field Sales.
- large shipment, north, Finance Desk.
- large claim, east (Finance Desk or Field Sales; “regional office”).
- small shipment, east, Client Services.
- small claim, south, Regional Ops.
Earlier: B rejected for large claim south, Field Sales; C rejected for south refunds, north claims, east shipments, east small claim.

Tentative rules:
- Use A for the confirmed A patterns above.
- Large refunds from east via Finance Desk: B.
- Small north shipments from Regional Ops with “second attempt”: C.
- Do not treat A as universal. Claims vary: small north via Regional Ops = A; large east / small south ≠ A.
- East claims: A is invalid; B/C not confirmed.
- Check request type, size, region, sender role, and repeat/urgency phrase before choosing.
- If first choice rejected, switch to nearest matching accept pattern; otherwise avoid rejected desk and test least-contradicted option.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2430)

Trust success/reject flag over explanatory text. Options usually A/B/C; a few logs show D—treat as anomaly until confirmed.

Confirmed accepts:
A: large invoice east Field Sales “asking twice”; large shipment south Finance Desk “no rush”; small shipment south Regional Ops “second attempt”; small claim north Regional Ops “no rush”.
B: large refund east Finance Desk “asking twice”; large refund north Field Sales “no rush”.
C: small shipment north Regional Ops “second attempt”; large invoice north Field Sales “no rush”.
Other accept: large claim north Partner Accounts “scanned” (REQ-2429, logged D—verify).

Rejected:
A: large invoice north Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk; large claim east; small shipment east Client Services; small claim south Regional Ops; small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice”; small shipment east Regional Ops “second attempt”; small refund east Regional Ops “scanned” (message says A invalid).
B: large claim south Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk “before EOD”; small shipment east Regional Ops “second attempt”; small refund east Regional Ops “scanned” (attempt rejected).
C: south refunds; north claims; east shipments; east small claims; small invoice east Partner Accounts; small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice”; large claim south (Field Sales/Partner Accounts).

Patterns:
- A only for listed A patterns; not universal.
- B fits large refunds (east Finance Desk, north Field Sales).
- C fits large invoice north Field Sales; small north shipment Regional Ops “second attempt”.
- Claims: small north Regional Ops “no rush” = A; large north Partner Accounts “scanned” accepted; large south B/C rejected—try A.
- Large shipment north Finance Desk: A and B rejected—try C.
- Small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice”: A rejected, C invalid—try B.
- Small refund east Regional Ops: A invalid, B rejected—try C.

If first choice rejected, switch to nearest matching accept pattern; avoid rejected desk; test least-contradicted option.

D: small claim south Regional Ops “scanned”. Large claim north Partner Accounts “scanned” likely D; verify.

Rejected/invalid:
A rejected: large invoice north Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk; large claim east; small shipment east Client Services; small claim south Regional Ops; small invoice/shipment/refund east Regional Ops; small invoice south Regional Ops “same as last month” (A invalid).
B rejected: large claim south Field Sales; large shipment north Finance Desk “before EOD”; small shipment east Regional Ops “second attempt”; small refund east Regional Ops “scanned”; small claim south Regional Ops “scanned” (B invalid).
C invalid/rejected: south refunds; north claims; east shipments; east small claims; small invoice east Partner Accounts; small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice”; large claim south; large invoice south Finance Desk “no rush”; small refund north Partner Accounts “no rush”; large invoice east Field Sales; small shipment east Partner Accounts “before EOD”.
D rejected: large claim north Finance Desk “scanned”; small shipment east Client Services.

Patterns:
- Large shipment north Finance Desk: A/B rejected—try C.
- Small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice”: A rejected, C invalid—try B.
- Small refund east Regional Ops: A invalid, B rejected—try C.
- Small claim south Regional Ops “scanned”: D accepted; B invalid.
- Claims: small north Regional Ops “no rush”=A; large north Partner Accounts “scanned” accepted; large south B/C rejected—try A.
If rejected, switch to nearest matching accept; avoid rejected desk/option; test least-contradicted.

D: small claim south Regional Ops “scanned”; large claim north Partner Accounts “scanned” likely D; small shipment east Regional Ops “before EOD”; large claim east Field Sales “through regional office”.

New rejections/invalid:
B rejected: large shipment east (regional office).
A rejected: large claim south “scanned”; large invoice south Finance Desk “scanned”.
D invalid: large invoice east Partner Accounts “regional office”; small invoice south Partner Accounts “scanned”.

Patterns:

- Large invoice east: use A; D invalid for Partner Accounts.
- Small shipment east Regional Ops “before EOD”: D accepted; B rejected for “second attempt”; D rejected for Client Services.

- Large claim south “scanned”: A/B/C rejected—try D.
- Large invoice south Finance Desk: C invalid for “no rush”, A rejected for “scanned”—try B.
- Small invoice south: A invalid for Regional Ops “same as last month”; D invalid for Partner Accounts “scanned”—try B/C.
If rejected, switch to nearest matching accept; avoid rejected desk/option; test least-contradicted.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2459)

Use +1 as accepted, +0 as rejected/invalid. Options A/B/C; D valid for selected Regional Ops/Partner claims/shipments.

Accepts by option:
A: large invoice east Field Sales “asking twice”/“no rush”; large shipment south Finance Desk “no rush”; small shipment south Regional Ops “second attempt”; small claim north Regional Ops “no rush”; small shipment south Partner Accounts “before EOD”.
B: large refund east Finance Desk “asking twice” (new REQ-2451 conflicts: B +0, D invalid); large refund north Field Sales “no rush”; small refund north Regional Ops “scanned”.
C: small shipment north Regional Ops “second attempt”; large invoice north Field Sales “no rush”; large shipment north Finance Desk “asking twice”.
D: small claim south Regional Ops “scanned” (confirmed); large claim north Partner Accounts “scanned”; small shipment east Regional Ops “before EOD”; large claim east Field Sales “through regional office” (confirmed).

New invalids:
- large claim north Field Sales “let me know if missing”: D invalid.
- small refund east Regional Ops “before EOD”: D invalid.
- large invoice east Finance Desk “no rush”: D invalid; A gave +0 (uncertain).
- large shipment north Partner Accounts “second attempt”: A invalid; C gave +0.
- large claim south Field Sales “through regional office”: C and D invalid; try A/B.
- large claim south “scanned”: A/B/C rejected; D still untested.
- D invalid for large invoice east Partner Accounts “regional office”; small invoice south Partner Accounts “scanned”.

If rejected, switch to nearest matching accept; avoid invalid desk/option; test least-contradicted.
